title: Customer Success Manager
description:
**About Us:** 




 Exotel is one of Southeast Asia’s largest cloud telephony companies. Our aim is to change the way enterprises look at customer communication. We build the best in class communication products that power the companies of today and tomorrow. Our technology enables customer communication for our clients such as Uber, Ola, Go\-Jek, Redbus, Flipkart, Quikr, Practo,Lazada, Redmart, to name a few.
 



 We are a young company with humble beginnings in 2011 that grew from a 3\-member team to 150\+ employees in 2018\. Our technology has connected 85 million people, powered 1\.2 billion customer calls, powered 3\.2 billion voice API calls, and 3\.2 billion business SMS calls. Read our 2018 growth story here.
 








  





**About the Role:** 




 The Customer Success Manager (CSM) is responsible for maintaining and expanding relationships with enterprise clients. The CSM is responsible for protecting recurring revenue targets, adoption of the use cases/product \& being the voice of the customer to provide feedback to the internal teams.
 



 This position entails managing customers post\-sales through launch and beyond. You’ll be the single point of contact for all their projects across teams, as well as an escalation for any support\-related issues. You’ll require a deep understanding of the platform we run and be able to communicate it effectively.
 








**What will you do?** 



* Empathise with every aspect of the customer experience, putting customers’ needs first.
* Guide and coach customers with proactive customer success processes.
* Own revenue and Gross Profit (GP) across your portfolio
* Drive retention while identifying opportunities to optimise costs and improve margins
* Develop a strong understanding of customer use cases and align solutions accordingly
* Should be able to handle API integrations
* Coach customers to be product experts and train their teams on best practices so they become increasingly self\-sufficient.
* Maintain high levels of customer engagement and satisfaction with a focus on customer loyalty.
* Partner closely with other cross\-functional teams (Customer Happiness, Product) members to translate business needs and product requirements into new solutions for customers.
* Adapt existing customer onboarding assets and work with product marketing to refine them over time.
* Onboarding new customers in order to ensure product adoption.
* Meets assigned targets for revenue retention, collections, and strategic objectives in assigned accounts
* Aggressively follow up with the accounts which are up for renewal and ensure minimum churn.
* Work closely with the product team to provide regular feedback to enhance \& built new features.
* Handling client escalations by collaborating with customer happiness (and other internal) team (s).
* You would be measured on:
* Logo retention ie 0% churn
* Protecting \& growing the recurring revenue in terms of Gross Revenue Retention (GRR) \& Net Revenue Retention (NRR)
* Feedback collected through NPS \& CSAT surveys
* Generating leads and collaborating with business account managers to close it
* Drive customer references and case studies













**What are we looking for?** 



* 2\-5 years of relevant work experience in customer\-facing customer success, account management, or a strategic consulting organisation. SaaS experiences a benefit
* Must be fluent in English.
* Knowledge of API Integrations is mandatory
* Self\-motivated, proactive team player with innovative ideas to inspire customer loyalty and adoption
* Strong interpersonal skills and experience in building strong relationships
* Good problem\-solving skills and technical aptitude
* Background working in a customer\-facing environment and driving initiatives to improve customer experience will be a great plus
* Ability to prioritise, multitask, and perform effectively under pressure
* Great attitude with the ability to foster a fun, productive working environment

**Role Overview**

 **Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance \& Operations – Supply Chain Management Manager**

 We expect the candidate to uphold Crowe’s values of Care, Trust, Courage, and Stewardship. These values define who we are. We expect all of our people to act ethically and with integrity at all times.

title: Customer Success Manager I
description:
**Company Description**
 At Nielsen, we are passionate about our work to power a better media future for all people by providing powerful insights that drive client decisions and deliver extraordinary results. Our talented, global workforce is dedicated to capturing audience engagement with content \- wherever and whenever it’s consumed. Together, we are proudly rooted in our deep legacy as we stand at the forefront of the media revolution. When you join Nielsen, you will join a dynamic team committed to excellence, perseverance, and the ambition to make an impact together. We champion you, because when you succeed, we do too. We enable your best to power our future.
   

  

**Job Description**
 As the primary point of contact for assigned customers and partners within Gracenote, this role involves comprehensive relationship management. The position requires proactive communication, troubleshooting, and quality management, while also focusing on upsell opportunities and customer health. Key responsibilities include handling escalations, developing action plans, managing reports and dashboards, coordinating product updates and integrations, and maintaining customer\-specific playbooks. This role demands a blend of customer service, industry expertise, and strategic thinking to ensure customer satisfaction and to drive business growth.
   

  

**As a Customer Success Manager You Will**
* Serve as the primary point of contact for assigned customers and partners
* Establish and maintain regular check\-ins, including dashboard and report reviews
* Create and deliver Quarterly Business Review (QBR) presentations, documenting highlights and action items.
* Monitor and ensure adherence to contractual commitments, including SLAs
* Stay informed and drive engagement around upcoming renewals
* Gather valuable feedback on customer/partner strategic goals and recommend solutions for customer use cases with a focus on upsell opportunities
* Provide input on overall customer and partner health
* Handle quality escalations and issues unresolved through standard Customer Care processes, collaborating with internal departments to ensure timely resolution and preventive measures.
* Initiate and monitor action plans for identified quality trends and provide regular progress updates to customers/partners
* Identify customers to receive standard Customer Dashboards, Quality Reports, and Product Usage Reports
* Coordinate setup of non\-standard customer reports and dashboards as needed
* Review key performance indicators (KPIs) regularly with customers/partners
* Communicate essential details to customers/partners about product retirements and replacement solutions
* Ensure customer readiness for new product features integration
* Create Product Inquiry tickets and coordinate customer responses
* Create and maintain customer and partner\-specific playbooks


**Qualifications**
* 3 to 6 years of relevant, customer\-facing experience, working in an account management role demonstrating successful customer satisfaction and relationship management outcomes
* Excellent verbal and written communication abilities for interacting with customers, partners, and internal teams.
* Experience in working with clients in the Media \& Entertainment industry is a plus
* Technical know\-how of product implementation and driving adoption
* Ability to identify, analyze, and resolve complex issues and find mutually beneficial solutions
* Flexibility to handle various customer needs and changing product landscapes
* Experience recommending solutions and identifying upsell opportunities
* Proficiency in creating and maintaining account documentation
* Experience guiding customers and partners through changes
* Data analysis experience, including the ability to interpret and present data
* Experience working with CS tools such as Zendesk (or similar ticketing tools), Dashboards, Monday.com (or similar tracking software), Salesforce (or similar CRM)
* Solid Presentation skills
* Strong attention to detail
* Ability to prioritize tasks and manage multiple responsibilities efficiently


**Additional Information**
 Please be aware that job\-seekers may be at risk of targeting by scammers seeking personal data or money. Nielsen recruiters will only contact you through official job boards, LinkedIn, or email with a nielsen.com domain. Be cautious of any outreach claiming to be from Nielsen via other messaging platforms or personal email addresses. Always verify that email communications come from an @nielsen.com address. If you're unsure about the authenticity of a job offer or communication, please contact Nielsen directly through our official website or verified social media channels.

title: Area Business Manager
description:
Business Introduction GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems.
   

  

 Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines.
   

  

 Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges. Position Summary You will lead commercial activities across a defined area in India, managing a small field team to deliver measurable business results. You will build trusted relationships with healthcare professionals and institutions, translate local insights into focused plans, and work closely with cross\-functional partners. We value clear communication, practical problem solving and supportive leadership. This role offers visible impact, career growth and the chance to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. Responsibilities This role will provide YOU the opportunity to lead key activities to progress YOUR career. These responsibilities include some of the following: \- Lead, coach and develop a team of field colleagues to achieve sales targets and high\-quality customer engagement. \- Build and maintain professional relationships with clinicians, hospital teams and other healthcare decision makers. \- Plan and execute territory activities that reflect local needs and company priorities. \- Monitor team performance and field activities, providing regular feedback and joint fieldwork. \- Analyse sales and market data to identify opportunities and shape local action plans. \- Work with colleagues in marketing, medical, supply chain and HR to ensure aligned execution and compliance. Why You? Work arrangement \- This role is on\-site with regular travel across the assigned territory. Basic Qualification We are seeking professionals with the following required skills and qualifications to help us achieve our goals: \- Bachelor’s degree in life sciences, pharmacy, business, or a related field. \- Minimum 5 years of experience in pharmaceutical sales or healthcare account management. \- At least 2 years in a first\-line people management or team lead role. \- Strong communication and interpersonal skills in English and local language(s). \- Proficiency in standard office software such as Word, Excel and PowerPoint. \- Valid driver’s license and willingness to travel regularly within the territory. Preferred Qualification If you have the following characteristics, it would be a plus: \- Experience working in hospital settings or with institutional accounts. \- Background in specialty or high\-value medicines. \- MBA or advanced business qualification. \- Experience using CRM systems and data\-driven territory management. \- Demonstrated success in coaching teams and improving field execution. \- Knowledge of local healthcare systems and payer landscapes. How to apply If this role speaks to you, please submit your CV and a short note describing how your experience fits the role and what motivates you to join us. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and life experiences. We value inclusion and want people who bring different perspectives to help us make a meaningful difference for patients. We look forward to hearing from you.
   

  

**Skills**
 Customer Centric Selling, Data to Insights, Digital Fluency, Omnichannel, Sales Territory Management, Scientific Literacy
   

  

**Why GSK?**
**Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.**
 GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2\.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale.
   

  

 People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we’re committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people.
   

  

**Inclusion at GSK:**
 As an employer committed to Inclusion, we encourage you to reach out if you need any adjustments during the recruitment process.
   

  

 Please contact our Recruitment Team at IN.recruitment\-adjustments@gsk.com to discuss your needs.
   

  

**Important notice to Employment businesses/ Agencies**
 GSK does not accept referrals from employment businesses and/or employment agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site. All employment businesses/agencies are required to contact GSK's commercial and general procurement/human resources department to obtain prior written authorization before referring any candidates to GSK. The obtaining of prior written authorization is a condition precedent to any agreement (verbal or written) between the employment business/ agency and GSK. In the absence of such written authorization being obtained any actions undertaken by the employment business/agency shall be deemed to have been performed without the consent or contractual agreement of GSK. GSK shall therefore not be liable for any fees arising from such actions or any fees arising from any referrals by employment businesses/agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site.
   

  

 It has come to our attention that the names of GlaxoSmithKline or GSK or our group companies are being used in connection with bogus job advertisements or through unsolicited emails asking candidates to make some payments for recruitment opportunities and interview. Please be advised that such advertisements and emails are not connected with the GlaxoSmithKline group in any way.
   

  

**GlaxoSmithKline does not charge any fee whatsoever for recruitment process. Please do not make payments to any individuals / entities in connection with recruitment with any GlaxoSmithKline (or GSK) group company at any worldwide location. Even if they claim that the money is refundable.**
 If you come across unsolicited email from email addresses not ending in gsk.com or job advertisements which state that you should contact an email address that does not end in “gsk.com”, you should disregard the same and inform us by emailing askus@gsk.com, so that we can confirm to you if the job is genuine.

 PKF Consulting Services LLP is a client\-facing consulting practice delivering ERP transformation, process documentation, and technical architecture advisory across industries. We work closely with clients to assess readiness, design future\-state processes, and support technology\-led business transformation.
 



**Role Purpose** 




 The Senior ERP Consultant will lead end\-to\-end ERP transformation workstreams for client engagements — from readiness assessment and solution design through configuration, testing, and go\-live support — while mentoring junior team members and acting as a key point of contact for client stakeholders.
 



**Key Responsibilities** 



* Lead ERP readiness assessments, fit\-gap analysis, and solution design workshops
* Own business requirement documentation (BRDs), process flows, and to\-be design for assigned modules
* Drive ERP configuration, integration, testing (SIT/UAT), and cutover planning
* Act as primary consultant liaison with client business and IT stakeholders
* Identify risks and process gaps and recommend practical, implementable solutions
* Review and guide the work of IT Analysts/junior consultants on the engagement
* Support project governance — status reporting, steering committee updates, and issue escalation
* Contribute to proposal development and solution estimation for new engagements



**Must\-Have Skills \& Experience** 



* 5–7 years of ERP consulting experience across at least one full implementation lifecycle
* Deep functional expertise in one or more ERP modules (Finance, SCM, Manufacturing, Sales/CRM, or similar) on SAP, Oracle, MS Dynamics, or NetSuite
* Strong track record of client\-facing delivery, requirement gathering, and solution design
* Experience leading or mentoring a small team of analysts/consultants
* Excellent stakeholder management, presentation, and documentation skills
* Willingness to travel to client locations, including outstation/international as needed



**Good to Have** 



* ERP certification(s) in the relevant module/platform
* Experience across multiple industries (manufacturing, retail, services, BFSI, etc.)
* Exposure to pre\-sales, solutioning, or proposal writing



**Qualifications** 



* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Commerce, or related field
* MBA or equivalent postgraduate qualification preferred



**Screening Questions (For HR Use)** 




*To be used during the initial HR screening call to assess fitment before scheduling technical/panel interviews.* 



1. Walk me through your total ERP consulting experience — how many full implementation lifecycles have you been part of, and in what capacity?
2. Which ERP platform(s) and module(s) are you strongest in (Finance, SCM, Manufacturing, Sales/CRM, etc.)?
3. Have you led a workstream or mentored junior consultants/analysts? Can you describe your scope of ownership?
4. Can you describe a solution design or fit\-gap exercise you led, and how you handled a difficult client requirement?
5. What is your current/last drawn CTC, and what are your expectations? (Budget for this role is capped at ₹25 LPA)
6. Are you open to outstation/international travel as required by the engagement?
7. What is your current notice period / earliest possible joining date?

**About KGC** 




 Karan Gupta Consulting (KGC) is a leading education and career consulting firm helping students and families with career planning, university selection, profile building, applications, essays, testing, scholarships, and visas.
 



 We are looking for a Student Success Manager to become a trusted point of contact for our enrolled students and their families.
 



  





**The Role** 




 The Student Success Manager will ensure that every student feels heard, supported, informed, and confident throughout their KGC journey.
 



 You will conduct regular meetings with students and parents to understand their progress, satisfaction, concerns, changing goals, and expectations, and coordinate internally to ensure the right action is taken.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**Student \& Parent Management** 



* Conduct regular student and parent meetings.
* Build strong, trusting relationships with students and families.
* Understand student goals, concerns, challenges, and changing priorities.
* Ensure students and parents feel comfortable raising issues or concerns.



**Progress \& Satisfaction** 



* Track student progress against their academic and profile\-building plans.
* Identify students who are falling behind, disengaged, or need additional support.
* Regularly assess student and parent satisfaction.
* Proactively identify concerns before they become larger problems.
* Collect and communicate actionable feedback to the internal team.



**Issue Resolution** 



* Act as the first point of contact for student and parent concerns.
* Listen objectively and empathetically and take ownership of issues.
* Coordinate with counsellors, editors, mentors, and other KGC teams to resolve concerns.
* Follow up to ensure issues have actually been resolved.
* Escalate sensitive matters when required.



**Internal Coordination** 



* Maintain clear communication across KGC teams.
* Ensure important student updates and decisions are documented.
* Track action points and follow\-ups.
* Provide management with visibility on student progress, satisfaction, and potential risks.



  





**What We Are Looking For** 




 The most important requirement is exceptional people and communication skills.
 



 The ideal candidate is:
 


* Extremely warm, approachable, and people\-friendly
* Highly empathetic and emotionally intelligent
* An exceptional listener and communicator
* Comfortable speaking with both young adults and parents
* Patient, calm, and mature
* Proactive and solution\-oriented
* Highly organised with excellent follow\-through
* Comfortable handling difficult or sensitive conversations
* Able to build trust quickly
* Comfortable managing multiple students and families



 This is not a back\-office coordination role. We need someone who can listen deeply, understand student and parent needs, communicate thoughtfully, and take ownership of finding a solution.
 



  





**Qualifications \& Experience** 



* Bachelor's degree or equivalent
* Prior experience in student counselling, education, customer success, client servicing, relationship management, hospitality, or another people\-facing role preferred, freshers are encouraged to apply
* Experience working with students and/or parents is an advantage
* Excellent spoken and written English
* Strong organisational and follow\-up skills



 Personality, empathy, communication, and relationship\-building ability will matter more than academic qualifications.
 



  





**What Success Looks Like** 




 A successful Student Success Manager will ensure that:
 


* Students know what they need to do and feel supported.
* Parents feel informed and confident.
* Concerns are identified and addressed early.
* Internal teams understand changing student needs.
* Students and families consistently feel that KGC genuinely understands and cares about their journey.



**Ideal Candidate** 




 A warm, emotionally intelligent, exceptionally articulate people\-person who makes every student and parent feel heard, supported, and confident that someone is taking ownership of their journey.

description:
About Pinch
 




  






 The last decade and a half has been dedicated to the rise of convenience in every way. Organisations, one after the other, have created products and services which make the life of customers convenient. Yet the pain, pressure and stress of the modern world has not really reduced, leave aside going away.
 




  






 At Pinch, our dream is to transform the physical environment of a family and help them create space for the truly important things, allowing them to focus on themselves and their mental well\-being to build a meaningful life, filled with purpose and joy. We wish to build a home management system, which not only does the daily chores, seamlessly and effortlessly, but also preempts the needs of our customers, enhances their lifestyle in every
 





 aspect while giving them the peace of mind to focus on achieving more in life. From full housekeeping to a quick tidy up or a dog walk, Pinch is available for the families all the time. We work as an extension of our customers’ family and bring to the table what is best for them.
 




  






 With our monthly plan, we combine services such as housekeeping, maintenance, food \& nutrition management, grocery resupply, laundry management, etc. tailored to the unique needs of each family. On top, a dedicated Lifestyle Manager helps them with any miscellaneous home requests, from decorating home with fresh flowers to arranging a repairman for the broken washing machine, to planning details of the next holiday, taking care of children or the elderly. Basically, anything and everything our customers and their families would need to live a comfortable, convenient, healthy, guilt\-free, and inspired life.
 




  






 How will we do it?
 





 There are three fundamental aspects of our business model which will help deliver this life\-transforming service:
 




  






 Lifestyle Manager: Armed with irrefutable professional attention, prompt service, strict quality controls and effective anticipation of needs, our dedicated lifestyle team helps customers in a variety of things. Be it sending flowers on birthdays, reminders for paying bills on time, and even recommending the latest home products. Our team of lifestyle managers are mapped to each family, do all the research, analysis and short list the best products and service experience for the customers.
 





 Trained Professionals: Offering a much more professional service than domestic helpers, with Pinch, customers are served by a team of home specialists who will handle all the housework, chores and running around. If they already have a helper, we will have them trained by us to maximise their potential and effectiveness.
 





 Technology: We take the hassle out of home management. Customers are given constant home and personal management advice, reminders and nudges, where the back\-end system incorporates an algorithm that remembers preferences and generates instructions to meet our customers’ home goals.
 




  






 Pinch has 4 broad customer segments:
 



* Individuals \& Families
* Landlords \& Second Home Owners
* Developers \& RWAs
* Corporates



  





*The Lifestyle Manager – An Extension of the Customer’s Family* 




  






 A Lifestyle Manager at Pinch is deeply empathetic, has a natural attitude towards helping people and is committed to improving lives for the better. Every family has their own set of needs, wants, preferences \& behaviours. Our Lifestyle Manager understands this, has the ability to develop a deep bond with a family \& its members, and designs solutions keeping their specific requirements in mind. S/he is warm, courteous, patient \& a good listener, with an eye for detail. S/he is able to not just solve for what the customer asks, but even anticipate or pre\-empt their needs, through her/his deep understanding of the family. Our customer’s peace of mind relies immensely on the Lifestyle Manager, and how efficiently and swiftly s/he works with the other teams at Pinch to be able to meet the customer’s requirements. The Lifestyle Manager has a service\-oriented mindset that puts the customer first, even before the company. Practically, s/he is an extension of the customer’s family \& thus, the most important link between the company \& the customer.
 




  





*Responsibilities of a Lifestyle Manager* 




  






 1\. Customer Onboarding
 



* Understand the prevailing context in a customer’s life with respect to the services we intend to provide.
* Explain how Pinch can help ease the customer’s life by delivering these services in a transformative manner.
* Handhold \& onboard the customer seamlessly onto Pinch’s ecosystem of services.



  






 2\. Solution Deployment
 



* Define \& agree upon the interventions needed for fulfilling the customer’s requirements.
* Deploy a set of trained domestic helps at the household to take care of the day\-to\-day chores, \& undertake periodic supervision of their work.
* Assign errands to the Operations Associates and monitor them for completion to the family’s satisfaction.



  






 3\. Partner Management
 



* Work with Pinch’s central partner ecosystem to deploy solutions at the customer’s household and fulfil any new requirements from time to time.
* Onboard and work with a local set of quality partners in the immediate vicinity of the customer’s location to bring about greater efficiency.
* Oversee the quality of work done by the partners and provide valuable feedback to the central Partnership teams on the same.



  






 4\. Customer Lifecycle Management
 



* Have deeper dialogues and conversations with the customer that ease them into the Pinch journey across the 5 stages of pain, convenience, pleasure, delight \& transformation.
* Educate and enable customers to adopt a wider range of Pinch’s services.



  






 5\. Customer Feedback \& Service Improvement
 



* Determine customer satisfaction with regard to the various services provided by Pinch.
* Identify \& work on areas of improvement. Iterate the solution design to continually keep enhancing customer service.
* Raise \& highlight any complaints, queries, grievances, feedback etc. to the relevant teams for resolution.



  






 Who are we looking for?
 



* Candidate with Hospitality background
* Candidate with communication and public relation skills
* Candidate with Event management, language and intercultural communication background
* Passionate about the cause the company is working towards
* Excited about wanting to work in a start\-up
* Self\-motivated \& loves taking initiative
* Growth mindset, focussed on improving business outcomes
* Able to hustle, loves being out on the ground, \& is willing to get his/her hands dirty
* Embraces ambiguity \& uncertainty
* Focused on problem\-solving, has a solution\-oriented mindset
* Hard\-working, is able to work for long hours
* Excellent team player
* Ability to multitask on multiple projects at the same time
* Ability to handle pressure and failure



  






 Qualifications:
 



* Bachelor's degree preferably in hospitality.

description:
The role
   

  

 You are a Customer Success Specialist who makes sure our customers get real value out of the FrankieOne platform. You own a portfolio of live accounts and you are their day to day point of contact for anything product, adoption or operational.
   

  

 Reporting to the Head of Customer Success, you sit in our offshore CS team managing our portfolio customers. This is the volume end of our book, and it is where the biggest opportunity sits. Today that engagement is largely reactive and driven by tickets. Your job is to help shift it toward something proactive: knowing which accounts are healthy, which ones are drifting, and getting ahead of problems before the customer raises them.
   

  

 Implementations own technical onboarding, so your focus is what happens after going live. You track usage, work pass rates, resolve and escalate issues alongside Technical Support, run training and product education, and keep the customer moving forward. Where you spot a genuine expansion signal, you qualify it and hand it to the Account Manager to run commercially.
   

  

 This is a technical space and it moves quickly. You will need to build real product depth to be credible with your customers, and we expect you to be up and running fast.
   

  

**Your Ticket To Success**
* Be an advocate. For Frankie, for the product, for our people and for our values.
* Energy. You enjoy a high energy, high velocity environment. You enjoy a challenge and relish the opportunity to create something you can be proud of.
* Customer centricity. Your focus is the customer. You work with them to lift adoption, improve pass rates, and resolve issues quickly. You run training, product walkthroughs and configuration conversations, and you understand the metrics that matter to their business.
* Portfolio management. You manage a portfolio of accounts through data, not gut feel. You use health signals across tickets, usage and product adoption to work out where to spend your time, and you keep retention high across the book.
* Technical depth. You build a strong working knowledge of the FrankieOne platform: KYC, KYB, AML, fraud, cascades and OneSDK. You can read verification data, diagnose why a check failed, and explain it clearly to a customer.
* Collaboration. You work closely with Technical Support on issue resolution, with Implementations on handover into business as usual, and with Product on feedback that shapes the roadmap. You surface and qualify expansion signals and hand them to Account Management.
* Mentor. You train and coach junior members of the team, peer review their work, and share what you know.


**In a Previous Life You Have**
* 3\+ years in a customer success, onboarding, implementation or product specialist role in B2B SaaS. Fintech, regtech or a compliance adjacent business is a strong advantage.
* Managed a portfolio of accounts and been accountable for retention across it.
* Worked in a technical product and built genuine depth in it, not just surface familiarity.
* Handled escalations and worked alongside technical teams to resolve them.
* Used data to prioritise your own work and to have better conversations with customers.
* Developed a passion for technology and how it solves customer problems.
* Built an eye for detail and a sense of what actually matters to the customer.
* Strong people skills, with a natural and collaborative presentation style.
* The ability to build rapport with anyone.


 At FrankieOne our goal is to help scale fintechs and financial institutions alike by providing seamless access to the global ecosystem of identity and fraud solutions. Our customisable orchestration platform, coupled with access to all global tools in one place, delivers unparalleled customer experiences. In order to do that, over the last four years we have created a unique culture focused on high performance, accountability, being frank \- essentially where Frankies can thrive and our customers can feel confident that they are compliant.

title: Senior Manager, Customer Experience
description:
**Organization Overview**
**Company Description**
**QAD** 
 is a leading provider of ERP solutions purpose\-built for manufacturing industries — automotive, life sciences, food \& beverage, high tech, and industrial. Serving thousands of global manufacturers, QAD's Adaptive Manufacturing Cloud helps companies operate with greater precision, agility, and intelligence.
   

  

 Enterprise software is entering a third era. The first gave manufacturers a System of Record — ERP that answered 'what do we have and what did we commit to?' The second gave them Data Infrastructure — the ability to move, analyse, and query that data at scale. The third era is domain\-specific intelligence: AI agents that can act autonomously on manufacturing data, but only if that data has been given the context, relationships, and governed rules that allow an agent to reason correctly.
   

  

**ERA — QAD's Enterprise Resource Allocation platform —** 
 is the domain intelligence layer that sits between any ERP and any AI agent. It encodes what manufacturing data means, governs what agents are permitted to do, and makes every autonomous decision traceable and accountable.
   

  

 Shift Timing: 2:00 PM – 11:00 PM IST
   

  

**Job Description**
 As the
 **Senior Manager, Customer Experience (Cloud Operations)** 
 , you will serve as a critical operational pillar within QAD’s global Cloud Operations organization, reporting directly to the Senior Director of Cloud Operations. In this high\-visibility leadership role, you will bridge strategic cloud direction with world\-class operational delivery.
   

  

 You will lead QAD’s IT Service Management (ITSM) framework, own major incident and problem resolution lifecycle, drive change management, and serve as the primary operational QAD interface for our outsourced Managed Service Provider (MSP) partner. Your core mission is to ensure secure, highly available, and performant AWS cloud infrastructure that delivers an exceptional, seamless customer experience for QAD's enterprise SaaS clients.
   

  

**Role Division \& Core Focus Areas**
 60% — IT Service Management \& Governance \| \| (Incident \& Problem Management, SLA Enforcement, MSP Governance)
   

  

 40% — AWS Cloud Ops, FinOps \& Release \| \| (AWS Infrastructure, Change Advisory, Release Management)
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Incident \& Problem Management Leadership
* Major Incident Command: Own the end\-to\-end lifecycle for P0, P1, and P2 incidents. Serve as the incident commander leading war room discussions, managing real\-time bridge calls, establishing stakeholder communication discipline, and driving swift resolution.
* Root Cause Analysis (RCA) \& Quality: Oversee rigorous RCA documentation and track permanent fixes to completion to eliminate repeat failures across complex cloud environments.
* Incident Protocol Enforcement: Maintain war room discipline, enforce post\-incident review SLAs, and ensure compliance with P0 real\-time handling protocols.
* Service Delivery \& SLA Governance
* SLA Performance: Own weekly SLA breach analyses and strictly enforce Response and Resolution SLA tiers (P0–P3\) across both internal teams and vendor partners.
* Queue \& Ticket Hygiene: Drive daily ticket health reviews, enforce priority accuracy, eliminate stalled tickets (e.g., "waiting on customer" discipline), and manage inactive P1/P2 queues.
* Executive Reporting: Deliver weekly operational SLA trend analysis and performance metrics to the Senior Director of Cloud Operations.
* MSP \& Outsourced Partner Governance
* Primary Partner Interface: Act as QAD’s daily operational interface for our outsourced managed services partner, collaborating directly with their Principal Engineering Manager level.
* Scope \& SLA Governance: Oversee Statement of Work (SOW) compliance, chair regular scope reviews, and strictly prevent out\-of\-scope creep in both directions. Hold the MSP accountable to contractual SLAs via weekly BAU tracker reviews.
* Formal Reviews \& RACI: Lead monthly formal service reviews and mandate actionable, written improvement plans for any SLA breaches. Maintain and enforce incident/change RACI matrices across QAD and MSP teams.
* Cutover \& Release Alignment: Oversee pre\-UAT and production cutover handovers with clear RACI framework execution, staffing confirmations, and standardized communication templates.
* Change Advisory \& Cloud Release Management
* CAB Leadership: Chair the Change Advisory Board (CAB) process, ensuring all high\-risk changes feature detailed rollback plans and clear go/no\-go criteria.
* Release Coordination: Maintain the global change calendar, coordinating seamlessly between cloud migrations, monthly patch releases, and MSP deployments.


**Qualifications**
**Qualifications \& Experience**
**Must\-Have Requirements**
* Experience: 12\+ years of total experience in Cloud/IT Operations, with 5\+ years specifically in ITSM or Service Delivery leadership roles.
* Incident Leadership: Proven track record in P0/P1 major incident command at enterprise scale.
* ITSM Mastery: Deep expertise in ITIL framework—specifically Incident, Problem, Change, SLA, and Supplier Management.
* Vendor/MSP Governance: Hands\-on experience governing third\-party MSPs or outsourced service partners (scope management, contractual SLAs, performance reviews).
* Cross\-Team RACI: Experience establishing and enforcing live incident/change RACI frameworks across combined internal and vendor teams.
* People Leadership \& Hours: 3\+ years of direct people management experience. Flexibility to work overlapping US East / EMEA business hours (approx. 2:00 PM – 11:00 PM IST) from Pune.
* Technical Depth: Solid experience with SaaS\-hosted infrastructure, Linux/Windows server administration, and AWS cloud operations.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Certifications: ITIL v4 Foundation or Managing Professional; AWS Certified SysOps Administrator or Cloud Practitioner; FinOps Certified Practitioner (FinOps Foundation).
* Tools: Hands\-on working knowledge of enterprise ITSM platforms like ServiceNow, Jira Service Management, or Zendesk.
* Domain Knowledge: Background in Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) SaaS hosting or manufacturing software environments.
* Vendor Background: Direct experience managing tier\-1 Indian IT services delivery partners (e.g., Persistent, Infosys, Wipro, HCL, or similar).
* AWS Expertise: Hands\-on working knowledge of core AWS services (EC2, EBS, VPC, IAM, S3, RDS, Security Groups, VPN, CloudWatch).


**Additional Information**
* Your health and well being are important to us at QAD. We provide programs that help you strike a healthy work\-life balance.
* Opportunity to join a growing business, launching into its next phase of expansion and transformation.
* Collaborative culture of smart and hard\-working people who support one another to get the job done.
* An atmosphere of growth and opportunity, where idea\-sharing is always prioritized over level or hierarchy.
* Compensation packages based on experience and desired skill set


**About QAD**
 QAD \| Redzone is redefining manufacturing and supply chains through its intelligent, adaptive platform that connects people, processes, and data into a single System of Action. With three core pillars — Redzone (frontline empowerment), Adaptive Applications (the intelligent backbone), and Champion AI (Agentic AI for manufacturing) — QAD \| Redzone helps manufacturers operate with Champion Pace, achieving measurable productivity, resilience, and growth in just 90 days.
   

  

 QAD is committed to ensuring that every employee feels they work in an environment that values their contributions, respects their unique perspectives and provides opportunities for growth regardless of background. QAD’s DEI program is driving higher levels of diversity, equity and inclusion so that employees can bring their whole self to work.
   

  

 We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and do not discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment because of race, color, sex, age, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, status as a veteran, and basis of disability or any other federal, state or local protected class.

 AWS Sales, Marketing, and Global Services (SMGS) is responsible for driving revenue, adoption, and growth from the largest and fastest growing small\- and mid\-market accounts to enterprise\-level customers including public sector.
   

  

 As a Customer Solution Manager you will work with the largest and most complex enterprises in the world, to enable their multi\-year journey to the cloud. In this new, highly visible, role you will ensure that all AWS teams work together effectively and efficiently to deliver migration, modernization and GenAI outcomes for the customer in relation to Amazon Web Services (AWS) Cloud.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 You will be a trusted advisor to the customer. You will leverage your complex program management, technical, organizational, and transformation expertise to understand customer's business and strategic goals, translate them into an executable plan, and drive the implementation to success by working with the customer, AWS, and our partners. You will understand your customers' biggest IT challenges and provide prescriptive guidance, based on AWS best practices, to guide them through their migration and modernization journey to AWS at scale.
   

  

 You will take end\-to\-end ownership of multiple migration, modernization and GenAI projects within a single enterprise or across several enterprises, utilizing your communication skills to interface with and influence a broad range of multi\-disciplinary teams (Business development, solutions architecture, support, product, professional services, and partners). The Customer Solution Manager role is responsible for cloud migration and modernization programs (incl. technical, operational, organizational, and education) that span across traditional IT teams and business units.
   

  

 Engaging from the inception stage onwards, you will have a deep understanding of your customer's business vision, culture, and processes, you will be your customer's voice within AWS, ensuring that their needs are accurately communicated to AWS leadership, product, and engineering teams. Engaging during the latter stages of the business cycle you will be responsible for ensuring consistent best\-practices are applied, including: (1\) ensuring Migration Readiness Assessment (MRA) is conducted and bringing in SMEs to deliver the migration foundations (e.g. landing zone build, security controls, operating model, training etc.), (2\) Migration kick off workshops are conducted (including stakeholder alignment), and (3\) Executive Steering Committees and reporting are established, including customer, partner, and AWS Cloud exec sponsors and ensure mechanisms are in place to identify and mitigate any identified risks. You should be passionate about delivering a great customer experience by delivering successful IT transformation programs. You will ensure that the customer IT and business stakeholders are aligned, to ensure broad adoption of the migration and modernization across the customer organization. You will use AWS mechanisms to inform the customer migration journey. Where required, you will lead the interaction with specialist teams, ProServ and Partners for handoffs, especially with respect to migreation, modernization and GenAI implementation.
   

  

 In addition to your customer facing responsibilities, you will help shape the rapidly growing Customer Solution Management function, where your passion to define and implement standard processes, methodologies, and tools will be highly valued. Passionate about customer value creation, you will be adept at measuring and quantifying customer value realization and ensuring it stays on path. Successful candidates will have a technical program management background, technology foundation and consultative mindset, be detail driven, and have experience in managing teams to deliver complex programs. You will be a passionate and proven leader with the ability to gain stakeholder buy\-in, communicate confidently at both the executive and project team level, and collaborate with a wide range of technical and non\-technical teams, regardless of geographical or organizational boundaries to ensure compliance with AWS Standards, policies and best practices. You will be comfortable in working with diverse teams to ensure appropriate partners are on\-boarded and involved in the migration as required. Be an active participant of steering committees and governance structures regardless of who is leading the migration and modernization and act as the point of contact for escalations if the migration and modernization hits barriers. You will be proactive in assessing Migration and modernization progress and design and implement plans to mitigate any risks or delays. Along with project management cadence, you will support the people and process pillars of migration including CCOE design and be the overall owner of reporting and system updates related to the health of migration. You will be a natural problem solver with a cool head that can deal with ambiguity, work autonomously to drive the deliver results for your customer, build IP, and share best practice across geographies.

**Job Description**

**India Customer Success Leader**




**Location: Gurgaon/ Mumbai**




**The Role**




 We are seeking a transformational Customer Success \& Consulting Leader to drive strategic growth, customer value realization, and executive engagement across NielsenIQ’s FMCG and Technology \& Durables businesses in India. This leader will define and execute the customer success strategy, build deep C\-suite relationships, and position NIQ as a trusted strategic partner for some of India's leading organizations.
   

  





 The successful candidate will combine strong commercial acumen, consulting expertise, customer leadership, and people management capabilities to accelerate growth, strengthen client partnerships, and deliver measurable business outcomes. They will serve as the voice of the customer internally while influencing strategic decisions across Commercial, Product, Analytics, Data Science, and Operations teams.
   

  





 This highly visible leadership role offers the opportunity to shape a future\-ready Customer Success organization, foster a culture of collaboration and excellence, and influence the future direction of NielsenIQ's customer engagement model
   

  





  

  





**Key Leadership Accountabilities**




**Strategic Customer Leadership**



* Build and manage strategic relationships with C\-suite executives across key customer accounts, positioning NIQ as a trusted advisor and growth partner for both the verticals
* Act as the voice of customers within NielsenIQ, ensuring customer priorities are reflected in product innovation, business planning, and service delivery strategies
* Lead customer transformation conversations, connecting market intelligence, analytics, and insights to measurable business outcomes. Drive customer adoption, value realization, retention, and long\-term partnership growth
* Serve as the executive escalation point for critical customer opportunities and challenges



  

  





**Drive Commercial Growth**



* Drive a disciplined account growth strategy by identifying whitespace opportunities, expanding strategic partnerships, and accelerating cross\-sell and upsell initiatives
* Partner closely with Commercial, Product, Pricing, and Operations teams to unlock sustainable growth and maximize customer lifetime value
* Influence revenue growth by aligning customer priorities with NIQ capabilities and innovation roadmap
* Create a scalable framework for value\-based customer engagement that strengthens loyalty and accelerates growth



**Lead a High\-Performing Organization**



* Inspire, align, and empower a high\-performing Customer Success and Consulting organization to achieve ambitious growth and customer impact objectives
* Develop future\-ready capabilities and a strong leadership pipeline through coaching, talent development, mentoring, and succession planning
* Foster a culture of collaboration, accountability, innovation, customer centricity, and excellence
* Drive organizational effectiveness through clear governance, workforce planning, resource allocation, and fit\-for\-purpose operating models
* Champion employee engagement, inclusion, and continuous learning to build a best\-in\-class Customer Success function



**Shape Cross\-Functional Strategy**



* Influence strategic priorities and decisions across Commercial, Product, Data Science, Engineering, Operations, and Analytics teams to deliver integrated customer outcomes
* Translate customer needs and market opportunities into clear priorities for business planning, solution development, and service innovation
* Lead cross\-functional initiatives that improve customer experience, operational excellence, solution adoption, and overall business performance
* Establish strong alignment and accountability across functions to ensure consistent execution against strategic customer commitments
* Contribute customer and market perspectives to NielsenIQ’s broader India business strategy and innovation agenda



  

  





**E** 
**stablish Customer Success Excellence**



* Define and institutionalize Customer Success methodologies, performance standards, governance mechanisms, and operating rhythms across the organization
* Build differentiated and scalable customer engagement models based on customer needs, strategic value, and growth potential
* Establish a disciplined approach to measuring customer health, adoption, value realization, satisfaction, retention, and growth
* Leverage customer insights, market intelligence, and performance data to proactively identify risks, resolve barriers, and unlock growth opportunities
* Drive continuous improvement across customer experience, service quality, consulting effectiveness, and operational efficiency
* Embed best practices and capability\-building programs that strengthen Customer Success maturity and deliver consistent customer outcomes



  

  





**What Success Looks Like**




 The successful leader will:
   

  




* Elevate NielsenIQ's strategic position with key customers
* Increase customer retention, advocacy, and lifetime value
* Accelerate revenue growth across existing customer portfolios
* Strengthen executive\-level customer relationships
* Improve Net Promoter Scores (NPS) and customer satisfaction metrics
* Build a highly engaged and high\-performing team
* Drive greater adoption of NielsenIQ's analytics, measurement, and consulting solutions
* Create a scalable and future\-ready Customer Success organization



  

  





**Why This Role?**




 This is not a traditional Customer Success leadership position.
   

  





 It is an opportunity to lead a strategically important function at the intersection of customer growth, consulting, analytics, and commercial strategy. You will shape how some of the world's leading brands leverage data and insights to make critical business decisions while building a high\-performing team and influencing the future direction of NielsenIQ's customer engagement model.
   

  

  

  




**Qualifications**

  

  




* 12\+ years of progressive leadership experience across Customer Success, Consulting, Consumer Intelligence, FMCG, Retail, Analytics, Professional Services, or related industries
* Proven track record of leading large customer\-facing teams, driving customer outcomes, and delivering sustainable business growth
* Demonstrated success building strategic client partnerships and influencing C\-suite stakeholders
* Strong commercial mindset with experience identifying and converting growth opportunities through expansion, cross\-sell, and value\-based engagement
* Strong understanding of how data, analytics, insights, and measurement solutions drive business performance and customer outcomes
* Experience working with FMCG clients and a strong understanding of the consumer goods landscape will be a distinct advantage

 You will partner closely with Resource Management, regional consulting teams, Engagement Managers, and project leaders to align staffing, skills, and delivery capacity with customer needs. You will also contribute directly to customer engagements, maintain deep expertise in Workday products and implementation methodology, and help shape the strategic direction of the Global Services and Professional Services organization.

* Model strong stakeholder management and collaborate effectively with customers, technical teams, developers, and operational partners.

 About You

* Strong consulting, organizational, and project\-management skills.
* Ability to manage multiple projects, initiatives, and priorities across time zones.
* Strong networking, mentoring, coaching, and problem\-solving capabilities.
* Proven ability to thrive in a fast\-paced, high\-growth, high\-energy environment.
* Excellent written, verbal, interpersonal, and stakeholder\-management skills.
* Ability to collaborate effectively with customers, consultants, developers, technical operations, and cross\-functional partners.

 We’re seeking a future team member for the role of Vice President, Client Processing Manager to join our Global Transfer Agency team. This role is located in Pune.
   

  

 In this role, you’ll make an impact in the following ways:
   

  

* Own the end\-to\-end Trade processing until settlement, including task allocation, controls, quality, and risk management
* Act as the primary point of contact for process queries, client escalations, and senior stakeholder communication
* Build strong, trusted client relationships and ensure consistent, accurate service delivery
* Ensure full compliance with BNY policies and all regulatory daily, weekly, monthly, and annual requirements, including timely escalation of control breaches
* Lead and manage the team, including workload planning, performance management, coaching, training, and all related people processes
* Monitor team process knowledge and quality, providing regular feedback and driving continuous improvement
* Identify process risks and errors, ensure root cause analysis, and implement sustainable corrective actions
* Drive the Digital and AI agenda by identifying automation opportunities and embedding digital solutions to deliver higher STP, increased efficiency, and reduced operational risk
* Lead and coordinate business and change initiatives impacting day to\-day operations


 To be successful in this role, we’re seeking the following:
   

  

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, or related field required.
* Advanced degree or professional certifications in finance or business administration preferred.
* Typically 8\+ years of experience in Transfer Agency or related field within financial services.
* Good experience of Trade processing, reconciliation, client service and people management required.
* Strong leadership and collaboration skills across diverse teams, with excellent interpersonal skills for client interactions.
* Experience in holding teams responsible to department KRI’s and undertaking annual performance reviews with teams.
* Demonstrable interest in continuous learning and delivery of process improvements, including the use of digital tools and AI.
